The '''[[Kesselian]] spice-mining droid''',<ref name="SPIN Declassified" /> also known simply as the '''[[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] mining droid''',<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader" /> was a model of [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droid]] used to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]<ref name="SPIN Declassified" /> in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader" />

[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was once disguised as this type of droid for a mission to Kessel in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] accompanied him disguised as a [[Kesselian security droid]].<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader" />
